hooks.name: Verify controller code meets accessibility rules

action.prompt: A controller file was just saved. Check it against these two accessibility rules from .kiro/steering/rules.md: (1) SEATED MODE — the controller must work without standing or large physical movements; flag any accelerometer threshold that would fail when the user is seated; (2) LEFT-HANDED SUPPORT — axis mappings must not hard-code a right-hand assumption; flag any place where a directional tilt is mapped to an action without considering mirroring. If both rules are satisfied, respond with a single line: 'Accessibility rules satisfied.' Otherwise list each violation with the file, line number, and what to fix.
